description: DRAW is a web application for transcribing structured historical weather records from scanned paper images. Its README explains a crowd-sourced workflow for tables that optical character recognition handles poorly, with multilingual localisation and application setup instructions. Users provide archive scans and transcription tasks; outputs are digitised observations that can later be checked and aggregated by place and date. Coverage and resolution follow the supplied archive, not a fixed observing network. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the code. A limitation is that volunteer transcription needs independent quality control and the README does not guarantee continued availability of any hosted service. The platform can recover older rainfall and temperature observations for flood or heat simulation baselines. The related ERA5 catalogue record offers modern reanalysis, while this workflow helps expose primary historical records. No scan or database dump was downloaded.
